content: Earlier 90% C.L. limits on g' from the same DeepCore data, which hold the potential at its value at the detector along every path, read off Fig. 1 of each paper, and drawn in Figs. 1 and 8 of ours.

garg_2026_le_lmu.reference: G. Garg et al., arXiv:2601.01220, Fig. 1 (solid blue curve)

garg_2026_symmetries.reference: G. Garg et al., arXiv:2606.03443, Fig. 1
garg_2026_symmetries.note: Their L_mu - L_tau curve coincides with that of B - L_e - 2L_tau, which suggests that it uses a charge of 1 per neutron (the factor of their Table I), not the e/(sin theta_W cos theta_W) of their Eq. (7); the paper does not say which.
